name: december-scribbles
description: December Scribbles — Next.js website and NestJS API

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @ds/api" "npm run dev -w @ds/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ds/contracts && npm run build -w @ds/api && npm run build -w @ds/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ds/api && npm run lint -w @ds/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ds/api && npm run test -w @ds/web
scripts.services:up: docker compose up -d postgres s3 mailpit
